jd_full:
Analyst - Pricing, Sainsbury's Data & Analytics
Salary: Competitive plus benefits. Location: London Store Support Centre and home, EC1M 6HA. Full time, permanent. Closing date: 24 November 2026.
What you'll do
As an Analyst in the Price & Promotion Analytics team, you will use data and insight to help shape how we price thousands of products and compete in a fast-moving retail market. You will analyse competitor, customer, sales and pricing data to understand our competitive position, uncover trends and opportunities and solve complex commercial problems. From developing analytical models that support smarter pricing decisions to measuring the impact of major price changes and value campaigns, your analysis will help us understand what is working and where to act next. You will work with Commercial Trading, Pricing, Value Strategy, Data Science and Engineering, turning business questions into robust analysis and clear recommendations.
Who you are
Commercially minded, curious and confident with ambiguity; strong SQL and Python; curious about AI and keen to experiment with agentic tools and workflows; collaborative, a clear communicator and data storyteller; able to balance multiple priorities.
Essential criteria
• Strong numerate background (degree or equivalent experience)
• Strong SQL skills and working knowledge of Python
• Experience with GitHub, Jira, Astronomer/Apache Airflow, or agentic AI tools and workflows is advantageous but not required
• Strong commercial acumen, connecting findings to customer, competitive and business outcomes
• Ability to deliver robust, high-impact analysis
• Skilled at simplifying complexity and structuring ambiguous problems
• Strong communication and storytelling ability
• Comfortable managing multiple priorities at speed
• Growth mindset and proactive approach to development
Benefits include colleague discount, pension and life cover, performance bonus up to 10%, holiday purchase, season ticket loans and flexible working where possible.

SSO Trading and Operations Accountant (advertised as Trading and Operations Analyst), Synthomer, Strategic Sourcing Operations team
Despite the title, this is not a traditional accounting role. It sits at the intersection of trading, procurement, supply chain and commercial finance, helping the business understand how market movements, pricing decisions and raw material flows affect profitability.

jd_full:
You will advise the directors on how to solve operational and commercial problems, create value, grow the business and improve performance across our lettings, management, sourcing and renovation services. You will use data and business analysis to give objective, evidence-based recommendations and to help the team build any new skills or processes we need.

Key responsibilities:
• Analyse pricing, occupancy, rental yield, void periods and market data across our managed and sourced properties, and report on what the data shows.
• Review how our lettings, property management, sourcing and renovation processes work, find inefficiencies and risks, and recommend practical improvements.
• Prepare business cases and financial appraisals for new markets, service lines and property investment opportunities, and present options to the directors.
• Identify and assess operational, financial and compliance risks, and recommend controls.
• Set up and track key performance indicators for each service, and produce regular management reports.
• Benchmark our services and fees against competitors and market trends.
• Work with the team to implement agreed changes and support them in developing the skills and processes needed to deliver them.

Requirements:
A bachelor's degree or above in management, business or a related subject. A master's degree in management is desirable.
Strong analytical skills and good competence with Excel or similar tools for data analysis and reporting.
Clear written and spoken communication, and the ability to present findings and recommendations to senior colleagues.
Interest in the UK residential property sector, including lettings, property management or investment.
Good organisation and the ability to work independently and manage multiple projects.

Desirable:
Experience in property, real estate, consultancy or a similar commercial analysis role.
Familiarity with property or CRM software and data visualisation tools.

Right to work:
Applicants must have the right to work in the UK. Deciti Homes holds a sponsor licence and may be able to sponsor a suitable candidate for a Skilled Worker visa, subject to eligibility.

How to apply: send your CV and a short cover letter to info@decitihomesltd.co.uk.
